title: Adaptation demand is shifting toward control, proof, substitution, and resilience
mechanism: Under instability, buyers may pay for workflow control, compliance proof, trusted guidance, substitution, and resilience rather than for novelty alone.
counter_signal: The social atlas and IBIS force registers are synthesis layers, while the Inc. 5000 figure is a source-linked company coverage measure. These may describe different mechanisms and do not establish population demand or willingness to pay.
next_test: Compare dated spending, procurement, adoption, retention, compliance cost, switching, and outcome measures across at least two independent source families for the same mechanism and geography.
promotion_gate: Do not promote until the control/proof/resilience mechanism is observed in compatible units and outcomes, with counterexamples and independent source lineage.
internal_bridge: Only after qualification: test company exposure through product demand, compliance operations, workflow adoption, retention, switching, or resilience investment data.
